Description: Checks active password policies require password history.
Risk: Without password history, users can immediately reuse recent passwords.

Code.Other:
1. In the Okta Admin Console, open the general-user password policy.
2. Edit password age or history settings.
3. Set password history to remember at least one previous password; use a higher value where required.
4. Save and test that a recently used password cannot be reused.

Recommendation.Text: Enable password history to prevent immediate reuse of recently used passwords.

Notes: Requires the Okta read scopes documented for the referenced management APIs.
